Венгерский часто опускает местоимение, е: Hungarian often omits the pronoun if the participant is already clear from the situation, but omission does not mean that the object is always written inside the verb ending.

Венгерский — агглютинативный язык. Грамм: Hungarian is an agglutinative language, and grammatical meanings are often expressed in suffixes that attach to the base of the word in a particular order.

Гармония гласных помогает сузить выбор с: Confessional harmony helps narrow the choice of a connective vowel, but it doesn't automatically tell you if it's needed or what shape it will be, and it's especially important not to deduce the shape just by the nullity: könyv contains ö, but correctly könyvet, not könyvöt.

Гармония помогает выбрать качество гласн: Harmony helps to choose the quality of a vowel, but does not itself answer the question of whether a connecting vowel is needed for a particular verb: the choice of model depends on the specific verb and the type of its basis.

Главная ловушка: в венгерском s обознача: Key trap for English speakers: Hungarian s is /ʃ/, like sh in ship, while sz is /s/, like s in see. This is the opposite of what English spelling may suggest.
Главная модель этого слайда: перед сущес: In Hungarian, an attributive adjective normally comes before the noun and stays unchanged; number and case are marked on the noun. This is fairly familiar to English speakers because English attributive adjectives also do not agree with the noun.
Главная ошибка: оставить предмет без при: The main mistake is leaving the possessed noun without its possessive suffix: not *Nekem van egy autó, but Nekem van egy autóm. English normally says “I have a car”, so do not copy the English structure word for word.
Главная формула всего урока:: The main formula of the whole lesson:
Главная функция — предложить время, прин: The main function is to offer time, accept it or offer another.
Главная цель 10.1 — не выучить все вариа: The main goal of 10.1 is not to learn all the endings, but to instantly distinguish between the three spatial relations. vowel harmony and choice - ban/-ben, -ba/-be, -ból/-ből parse in 10.2.
Главная цель 7.1 — научиться замечать пр: The main goal of 7.1 is to learn to notice the direct addition. In Hungarian, the noun-object usually has a score -t; specific educational models are parsed by 7.2.
Главная цель — узнать контраст, а не выу: The main goal is to learn the contrast, not to learn the second paradigm by heart.
Главная цель: понятный маршрут и коррект: The main goal is to understand the route and correct forms L11.
Главная часть сообщает действие или резу: The main part tells you the action or the result, and the subdivision with mert tells you the cause. Between the parts, you put a comma.
The main dish is rántott sajt.
Главное о j и ly:: The main thing about j and ly:
Главный герой ищет квартиру:: The main character is looking for an apartment:
Главный навык 19.7 — не считать каждую ф: The main skill of 19.7 is not to consider every form of the present as an "event now." Look at the time, the paragraph and the overall plan.
Главный навык урока — не узнавать оконча: The main skill of the lesson is not to recognize the end by eye, but to explain the choice of form through a direct object.
Главный результат урока — не запомнить о: The main result of the lesson is not to memorize one suffix, but to be able to explain the choice of form in a particular situation.
Главный результат урока — не запомнить ш: The main result of the lesson is not to memorize the six suffixes separately, but to stably pass the chain: spatial meaning → Hol/Hová/Honnan → family of place → harmonic version → ready-made form.
Главный результат урока — не список меди: The main result of the lesson is not a list of medical words, but the ability to clearly describe a fictional state, answer questions, understand simple instructions and clarify the incomprehensible.
Главный результат урока — не список терм: The main result of the lesson is not a list of terms, but the ability to choose the appropriate model for a particular work situation.
Главный результат урока — способность пр: The main result of the lesson is the ability to conduct one agreed route: choose a transport, buy a ticket, solve a problem at the station, check in at a hotel and specify the road.
Главный результат урока — уметь не тольк: The main result of the lesson is to be able not only to build a form, but also to explain why it is needed in a particular replica.
Глагол \"eszik\" (есть) – неправильный:: The verb eszik is incorrect: its past form is evett (not the expected eszett). Vár, kér and tanul are correct verbs, they obey general rules.
Глагол \"lenni\" (быть) в повелительном: The verb "lenni" (to be) in the imperative inclination has a special basis "légy-": légy! (be!) for the 2nd person (te). "legyen!" is the form for ő/Ön (let there be/be!).
Глагол kér — просить, запрашивать и зака: verb kér - ask, request and order
Глагол köt — вязать, завязывать и связыв: verb köt - knit, tie and bind
Глагол lenni не образует повелительные ф: The verb lenni does not form imperative forms in a simple model with a visible -j.
Глагол lenni непереходный: он не имеет о: The verb lenni is nontransitional: it doesn't have a particular paradigm, but we choose form by face and number.
Глагол vár — «ждать»: полная парадигма и: The verb vár - "wait": the complete paradigm and use
Глагол «köhög» (кашлять) в 1-м лице един: The verb "köhög" (cough) in the 1st person of the singular: köhög + ök = köhögök (I cough).
Глагол «быть»: формы настоящего времени: The Verb “To Be”: The Forms of the Present Time and Two Different Rules
Глагол движения сам по себе не выбирает: The verb of motion does not itself choose a family: the forms szobába, postára and Péterhez all respond to Hová?, but express different spatial relationships.
Глагол движения сам по себе недостаточен: The verb of movement is not sufficient, for example, "going towards the goal" and "going away" require different questions.
Глагол не заменяет падеж. Как и на 10.6,: The verb does not replace the case. Like 10.6, the shape of the place determines its role in the situation.
Глагол переходный, но здесь говорящий со: The verb is transitional, but here the speaker is reporting a reading without a specific text known from the context, so it uses an indefinite form.
Глаголы разные, но пространственная роль: The verbs are different, but the spatial role is the same:
Глагольная форма одинакова. Разницу созд: The verb form is the same. The difference is made by the object.
Глубокий анализ видов спряжения, сложные: A deep analysis of conjugation types, complex cases with pronouns (engem, téged, titeket), form -lak/-lek ("I am you ...") and practical contrasts.
Глухая пара звука gy: положение языка по: The voiceless counterpart of gy, /c/. The tongue position is similar, but the vocal folds do not vibrate. English has no exact equivalent.
Говорение: вымышленная поездка с проблем: Talking: A fictional trip with a problem
Говорение: маршрут или простая процедура: Talking: a route or a simple procedure
Говорение: могу, нужно, можно, хочу: Saying: I can, I need, I can, I want
Говорение: мои привычки и конкретный выб: Talking: My Habits and Specific Choices

Говори 1,5–2 минуты. Используй 6 смыслов: Speak 1.5-2 minutes. Use 6 semantic blocks and at least one form of c -val/-vel in a natural context.
Говори 1,5–2 минуты: место/спутник → зак: Say 1.5-2 minutes: location/satellite → order → what you like → problem → solution → outcome. If you get lost, use the short recovery phrase and go ahead.
Говори 1,5–2 минуты: объясни маршрут или: Say 1.5-2 minutes: explain a route or a simple procedure, use sequence, 4-5 instructions, and a clear register.
Говори 1,5–2 минуты: что умеешь, чему хо: Say 1.5-2 minutes: what you can do, what you want to learn, what you have to do, what you don’t have to do, and what is forbidden in a familiar place.
Говори 1.5–2 минуты о вчерашнем дне: утр: Talk 1.5-2 minutes about yesterday: morning → day → evening. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори 1.5–2 минуты о вымышленной покупк: Talk 1.5-2 minutes about a fictional purchase. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори 1.5–2 минуты о вымышленном посеще: Talk 1.5-2 minutes about a fictional restaurant visit. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори 1–1.5 минуты и сравни два места,: Talk for 1-1.5 minutes and compare two places, a product or other familiar options. This is optional textual self-practice without a microphone, automatic score and evidence.
Говори 1–1.5 минуты о вымышленной семье:: Talk 1-1.5 minutes about a fictional family: relationship, age or job and place. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори 1–1.5 минуты о местах дня: где на: Talk 1-1.5 minutes about the places of the day: where you are, where you enter and where you leave. These are text instructions without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори 1–1.5 минуты о простом маршруте п: Talk 1-1.5 minutes about a simple route around the city. Use the present time and only the familiar grammar L1-L11. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори 2–3 минуты о вымышленной поездке:: Talk 2-3 minutes about a fictional trip: destination, transportation, schedule, one problem, how it was solved, hotel/accommodation and overall assessment. Use past tense, sequence markers, opinion and reason.
Говори 2–3 минуты по теме: Beszéljen a m: Speak 2-3 minutes on the topic: Beszéljen a munkatapasztalatáról, a feladatairól, két erősségéről, és arról, milyen munkát keres. Name your previous role/experience, responsibilities, two strengths, desired job, one reason and availability to start with.
Говори 2–3 минуты. Выбери тему: большой: Speak 2-3 minutes. Choose a topic: big or small city; home or office; car or public transport; self-study or teacher. Build an answer: position → reason → example → second reason → counterargument → answer → conclusion.
Говори 30–60 секунд по опорам. Без микро: Speak for 30 to 60 seconds on the poles. No microphone, score and evidence.
Говори 90–120 секунд на ту же коммуникат: Talk 90 to 120 seconds on the same communicative subject, but don't repeat the written text verbatim. Compare your usual habits to a particular book, movie or program now.
Говори около 1 минуты о том, что ты обыч: Talk for about 1 minute about what you normally eat, drink, buy, read or watch. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори около 1.5 минуты о дороге от дома: Talk about 1.5 minutes of driving from your home or station to a familiar place. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори около 2 минут на тему: Mit csinál: Talk for about 2 minutes on the topic: Mit csinálnál, ha egy hónapig nem kellene dolgoznod? Use at least 4 conventional forms, 2 reasons and 1 ha-clause.
Говори около 2 минут о следующей неделе:: Talk about about 2 minutes about next week: work or school, one appointment, weekend plans, one expected event and one possible change. This is text self-practice without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори около 2 минут о типичном буднем д: Talk about a typical weekday for about 2 minutes and compare it to a weekend. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори около 2 минут. Назови любимый сез: Talk for about 2 minutes. Name your favorite season, typical weather, clothes, classes, and one time when the weather changes your plan.
Говори около 2 минут. Это текстовая инст: Talk for about 2 minutes. This is a text instruction without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори около 2 минут. Это языковая практ: Talk for about 2 minutes. This is a language practice, not a real medical assessment. Describe a recent fictional problem: symptoms, onset, what has already done, whether it has gotten better or worse, and what would have been asked by a doctor.
Говори около 2 минут: будний день → врем: Talk about 2 minutes: weekday → time → transport → frequency → evening → one difference of the weekend. Without a microphone, score and evidence.
Говори по шести опорам: когда → утро → д: Speak on six pillars: when → morning → day → person / place → one denial → evening and opinion. The goal is about 1.5-2 minutes.
Говори примерно 1.5–2 минуты: что ты уме: Say for about 1.5-2 minutes: what you can do well, what you want to learn, what you have to do every day, what you don't have to do, what you don't have to do, what you don't have to do, what you don't do in a place you know, and that's just a textual basis for self-practice -- without writing down or evaluating.
Говори примерно 2–2.5 минуты и перескажи: Speak for about 2 to 2.5 minutes and retell a fictional event: setting, sequence, problem, action, result, and opinion. This is just text self-practice — no microphone, score and evidence.
Говорите по этим опорам, не читая готовы: Speak on these pillars without reading the finished paragraph.
They say of a few people: "they."
The speaker includes himself in the group: "we."
Говорящий обращается к одному собеседник: The speaker speaks to one person: “You.”
Год → месяц → день: A year, a month, a day
Готовность к A1 означает не знание всех: Readiness for A1 does not mean knowing all of these forms in advance, but a confident A0 base: you read familiar words, use articles, distinguish between a number and a plural, form the present time, and understand a simple schedule.
Готово: ты выбрал(а) подходящие приветст: Ready: You have selected the appropriate greetings and goodbyes and worked out short responses by model.
Грамматическая связь становится инструме: Grammar communication becomes a tool for practical communication
Грамматически возможная форма не всегда: Grammatically possible form is not always the most natural cue. Check not only the ending, but also the speech situation.
Грамматически знакомые слова ещё не гара: Grammatically familiar words don't guarantee a logical sentence. Check the order of events: morning → day → after work → evening.

Не вводи новую систему будущего времени: Don’t introduce a new future-time system for writing. Use familiar predictive blocks with várható/lesz and simple constructions with Lesson17.
Не вводим здесь новую разговорную систем: We do not introduce a new time-speaker system here.

Не все долгие гласные сокращаются:: Not all long vowels are shortened:
Не все связующие элементы являются союза: Not all the connecting elements are unions; some connect the parts of a sentence, others show the author's position, example, transition or outcome.
Не вставляй форму искусственно ради гало: Don't put a shape in artificially for the sake of a tick. It has to really mean accompaniment or a mode of action.
Не выбирай -ba/-be просто потому, что в: Don't choose -ba/-be simply because the sentence has a verb for a movement. First define the role of the place: if it's a goal, specify Hová?. The source of the movement will be denoted differently by 10.5.
Не выбирай вариант ответа по одному знак: Don't pick the answer for a word you know, but first find the proof in the text: the original plan, the reason for the change, the new arrangement or the forecast.
Не выбирай вариант только потому, что в: Don’t choose a word just because it’s a familiar word.
Не выбирай один из четырёх суффиксов и н: Don't pick one of the four suffixes, and don't add the usual endings mechanically. Forms are better studied by face; it's especially important to remember the first-person shape in -nék.
Не выбирай ответ по одному знакомому сло: Don't pick an answer for a familiar word. Questions test the cause, the change of plan, the advice and the final decision of the family.
Don't pick an answer for one familiar word. For each question, find a sentence or phrase that serves as proof.
Не выбирай союз только по русскому перев: Do not choose the Hungarian conjunction from an English translation alone. First ask whether the result happens despite an obstacle (concession: although/even though) or depends on a condition being met (if).
Не выбирай суффикс по последней букве сл: Don't pick the last letter of the word. Look at the vowel bases and especially distinguish between the front unabundled e/é/i/í and the front corrugated ö/ő/ü/ű.
Не выбирай форму по одному глаголу и не: Do not choose the suffix from the verb alone or by mechanically translating an English preposition. First identify the role of the place: location, destination, or source.
Не выбирай форму по русскому «в / на / и: Do not choose the Hungarian form by mechanically matching English “in / on / from / off”. The standard Hungarian location family for a place may differ from the English preposition.
Не выбирай форму по русскому предлогу и: Do not choose the Hungarian form from an English preposition and do not start with the suffix. First identify the spatial question:
Не выбирай форму только по русскому слов: Do not choose the Hungarian form from English “want” alone. Ask whether you are stating a direct intention (“want”) or making a polite wish/request, where English often uses “would like”.
Не выбирайте вариант только потому, что: Don't choose a variant just because the word looks familiar. The answer must match the verb, object, and sequence of events in the record.
Не выбирайте владельца только по прилага: Do not choose the owner only by adjective.
Не выбирайте ответ только по последней б: Do not choose the answer only by the last letter without checking the meaning.
Не выбирайте соединительную гласную толь: Don't choose a connective vowel from a simple table. vowel harmony helps, but doesn't always predict the form completely: asztalok, házak, kertek, gyümölcsök. It's useful to learn a new noun with its plural.
Не выводи гармонию заново. На этом этапе: Don't re-invent the harmony. At this point, the form should be recognized quickly.
Не выводи общее правило только из артикл: Don’t derive the general rule from a/az or egy. Here, two examples are a familiar guide; the complete system of definite/indefinite conjugation is wider.
Не выводи правило заново. Просто проверь: Don't re-infer the rule. Just check if you know the spelling correctly automatically.
Не выводите все формы из одного механиче: Don't deduce all forms from one mechanical rule. At A1, these frequent sets need to be known as proven models.
Не выводите точную форму только по одном: Don’t get the exact form by one rule of harmony:
Не выводите форму по последней гласной:: Do not display the form by the last vowel:
Не глядя на объяснения, классифицируй се: Without looking at explanations, classify seven examples: without object, with article, without article, pronoun or first/second person object.
Не делай вывод «любое русское из = -ból/: Do not conclude that every English “from” or “out of” equals -ból/-ből. Leaving a surface uses another family, while moving away from a person or object uses a third. These follow Lesson 10.
Не делай вывод, что теперь можно механич: Don't assume that you can now mechanically form the past form of any new verb, and the bottom line is L13 is to use the set in context with confidence.
Не делай правило «piros = светло-красный: Don't make the rule, "piros = light red, vörös = dark red." This mechanical division is unreliable. For a normal object, A1 is a safe active model:
Don't make the rule "there's movement -hoz." Movement responds to Hová?, but family depends on meaning: in, standard place or to/from a point.
Не делай правило «придаточное = всегда t: Don’t make the rule “adjunct = always tárgyas”: here the function of a particular part of a sentence is important.
Не делай правило «русское в = L10» или «: Do not make a rule that English “in” always means L10 or “on” always means L11. These correspondences sometimes happen to match, but they are not a reliable way to choose the Hungarian location family.
Не делайте вывод только по окончанию.\n: Don't just infer from the end. For example, the form.
Не делайте вывод, что пропущенное местои: Don’t assume that the missing pronoun is always uniquely defined by the shape of the verb. In Péternek hívnak, the meaning of “me” is reconstructed from a stable situation of representation and context; the form hívnak does not itself encode a first-person object.
Не добавляем новую грамматику. Цель — бы: We don't add new grammar, but we want to quickly extract phrases that we've learned from a real situation.
Не добавляй -j к инфинитиву целиком. Сна: Don't add -j to the infinitive in its entirety. First, remove -ni and find the base. In some verbs, -j then merges with the last consonant or the form becomes irregular.
Не добавляй -t механически к любому глаг: Don't add -t mechanically to any verb. In Hungarian, there are base changes, connecting vowels and different personal endings. The complete system will be in L20.
Не добавляй leg- к исходному прилагатель: Don't add leg- to the original adjective at random: *legnagy, *legjó, *legolcsó are wrong. Remember nagyobb, jobb, olcsóbb first, then legnagyobb, legjobb, legolcsóbb.
Не добавляй mert и ezért в одну цепочку: Don't add mert and ezért to the same chain automatically. First decide where the cause is and where the result is; sometimes it's better to split the thought into two sentences.
Не добавляй более сложные разговорные мо: Don’t add more complex conversational time models: you only need a clear basic timeline.
Не добавляй личное окончание к инфинитив: Don't add personal endings to the infinitive. In the design of the future, fog changes, and the action stays in the basic infinitive.
Не добавляй лишние чувствительные сведен: Don’t add sensitive information or overstate language or experience, only provide information that is useful for a particular job.
Не добавляйте van после профессии, нацио: Do not add van after a profession, nationality or third-person name: Ő diák. Ő magyar. But for van location, you need Ő itt van.
Не добавляйте в это упражнение формы: Do not add forms to this exercise.
Не добавляйте предложение только ради ко: Don't add a sentence just for the sake of quantity. Four right short lines are better than six long lines with new and untested grammar.
Не добавляйте сложные новые формы только: Don't add complex new shapes just for the sake of quantity. One clear and grammatically controlled attachment construct fits the rubric.
Не достаточно сказать только номер автоб: It is not enough to say only the number of the bus – name the exit point.
Не забудь назвать именно остановку выход: Don’t forget to name the exit stop, not just the bus number.
Не заменяй tud и lehet друг другом тольк: Do not treat tud and lehet as interchangeable just because English can use “can” for both. Tud primarily expresses a person’s ability/capacity; lehet + infinitive expresses situational possibility or permission.
Не заменяй обязанности общими словами. Л: Don't use generic words for responsibilities. It's better to say two or three things that are being tested: what is being answered, organized, decided, prepared or coordinated.
Не записывай только перевод существитель: Don't just write down the translation of the noun.
Не заполняй пробел догадкой из «обычного: Don't fill the gap with a "normal routine" guess. The answer must come from the record.
Не заполняй таблицу по памяти из вариант: Don't fill out the memory table of the answer options. First, find the proof in the text itself.
Не заполняй эту карту из вариантов ответ: Don't fill out this map of the answers. Find the corresponding paragraph first, and then formulate a brief note.
Не заполняйте категории по одному упомин: Don't fill in categories by mentioning a word, for example, a word might appear in a text as what Nora is looking for, but that doesn't prove she bought it.
Не заучивай model answer целиком. Сначал: Don't memorize model answer in its entirety. First define the function of your replica, then compile your own phrase from familiar models.
Не заучивай модели как один фиксированны: Don't memorize the models as one fixed dialog. After the first pass, replace the könyvtár, kávézó and étterem with other familiar places, but keep the correct spatial role.
Не заучивай полные model answers. Сначал: Don’t memorize the full model answers. First define the communicative function of your replica and then collect the phrase.
Не измеряй прогресс только количеством в: Don't measure progress by just the number of words you learn. Keep track of what you understand, retold, wrote, said and corrected.
Не используй -lak/-lek с вежливым Ön / Ö: Don’t use –lak/-lek with polite Ön/Önöket: grammatically, it’s the 3rd person, so there’s a regular, defined conjugation.
Не используй механическое правило «слово: Don’t use the mechanical rule “word + bb.” Forms *nagybb, *szépbb, *jóbb and *kicsibb are incorrect.
Не используй механическую формулу «увиде: Don't use the mechanical formula "saw the shape of the 3rd person and just added a personal ending." The surface shape can change, and you'll see that in the next slides.
Не используй правило «есть движение → Ho: Don’t use the rule “is there movement → Hová?” The movement can lead to a goal or come from a source, so first determine the meaning of the situation.
Не используй правило «к любой словарной: Don't use the rule "just add -ni to any vocabulary form." For frequent irregular verbs, the infinitive must be learned in its entirety.
Не используй реальные персональные данны: Don't use real personal data. Fictitious information is allowed for interviews, resumes and letters.
Не используйте transcript до первого сам: Don't use transcript until you first listen to it yourself, otherwise activity will stop listening.
Не используйте здесь новые формы könyvet: Don’t use the new forms könyvet, szavakat, and szeretem. The accusatory case -t and the system-defined conjugation begin later; sentences are now only built from familiar A0 structures.
Не используйте знание реальных семей: вс: Don’t use real family knowledge: all families in the text are fictional.
Не ищем «возвратность» по -ik: сначала з: Do not look for "return" in -ik: first the meaning of the verb
Не ищи одинаковое ключевое слово в вопро: Don't search for the same keyword in question and answer. First, reconstruct the situation: where you are, where you are going, where you are coming from, ask for a route or correct a misunderstanding.
Don't look for a single word that matches the answer. For each question, find a whole sentence or a bunch of sentences that confirm the choice.
Не ищите в аудировании историю про поезд: Don’t look for a train story in listening: a separate entry tells about another person and other activities.
Не каждое название продукта является пря: Not every product name is a direct addition, and not every product Nora buys is a direct addition. First define the verb and the meaning of the action, and then decide what role the noun plays.
Не каждое предложение с ha имеет две усл: Not every sentence with ha has two conventional forms.
Не каждый человек в предложении — прямой: Not everyone in a sentence is a direct object.
Не каждый элемент перед глаголом автомат: Not every element before a verb is automatically a contrast focus; in a neutral phrase, the verb can also have the usual additions and circumstances, and the focus is determined by the context, stress and location of the other elements.
Не копируй Reading 10.7 и не превращай т: Don't copy Reading 10.7 and turn the text into a form list. You need a connected route with the actions. Use only the inner family L10; other local families will start later.
Не копируй готовый образец. Сначала сост: Don't copy the finished sample. First, make your plan out of 7 semantic blocks and then write the full text.
Не копируй полный образец до собственной: Don't copy the full sample before you try. A direct lehet question is enough to request an alternative; a new construction with a question particle is not studied separately here.
Не ловите отдельное знакомое слово.\n: Don't catch a single familiar word. Listen to a little bit of meaning:
Не меняй порядок шагов во время речи. Сн: Don't change the order of steps in your speech. First, name the first landmark, then the next.
Не механическое «слово + bb», а готовые: Not mechanical word + bb, but ready-made frequent forms:
Не называй mert, hogy и ezért взаимозаме: Don't call mert, hogy and ezért interchangeable. They show different links: cause, purpose and outcome.
Не называй эти местоимения неопределённы: Don't call these pronouns indefinite. They're specific in meaning, but they require an indefinite paradigm of the verb.
Не начинай писать сразу длинный абзац. С: Don't start writing a long paragraph at once. First, make a five-part plan: topic → option A → option B → direct comparison → choice and reason.
Не начинай пока образовывать сравнительн: Don't start forming comparative forms yet. In this step, the challenge is to learn the basic adjectives with confidence.
Не начинай с окончания. Начинай со смысл: Don't start with the end. Start with the meaning of the situation.
Не начинай с окончания. Сначала определи: Don't start with the end. First, define the spatial relation.
Не начинай с окончания. Сначала установи: Don't start with the end. First, you need to figure out who should act, if there's a straight object, and what register you need.
Не начинай с полного перевода русского т: Do not begin by translating a complete English text into Hungarian. First build a Hungarian outline from familiar actions, time expressions, and frequency words.
Не начинайте с полного перевода русского: Do not begin by translating a complete English paragraph. First build a short plan from Hungarian words and patterns you already know from the lesson.
Не начинайте сразу с длинного перечислен: Don't start with a long list of names. First, tell us which family you're talking about.
Не нужно говорить одинаково долго о кажд: You don't have to talk about each block the same length, but you have to get the listener to understand the sequence of the day.
Не нужно заново выводить правила. На чте: You don't have to re-devote the rules. You can read quickly enough to learn the meaning of a familiar person.
Не нужно каждый раз строить длинную исто: You don't have to build a long story every time. A short, accurate replica is better than a complicated phrase with lost meaning.
Не нужно описывать второй полный распоря: You don't have to describe the second complete routine. A well-formulated contrast is enough.
Не нужно повторять гармонию целиком. Зде: You don't have to repeat the whole harmony. You have to hear the difference.
Не нужно сейчас учить все порядковые фор: You do not need to learn all the ordinal forms of the days of the month: it is enough to understand the model on a few frequent examples.
Не нужно соединять предложения сложными: No need to connect sentences in complex unions: these three bundles are enough for the A1 level.
Не нужно специально чередовать два спряж: You don't have to alternate between two conjugations in each story, so you can choose the meaning and the object, and then you can put the natural form of the verb.
Не нужно ставить связку перед каждым пре: You don't have to put a bundle before every sentence, use them where they help the reader see order.
Не образуйте множественное число механич: Don't create a plural mechanically. Compare: ajtó>> ajtók, lámpa>> lámpák, ágy>> ágyak, tükör>> tükrök. These words have different models.
Не образуйте формы olvassz, nézsz, főzsz: Don't form forms olvassz, nézsz, főzsz or edzsz. Correct: olvasol, nézel, főzöl, edzel. The ending option is chosen by vowel harmony.
Не образуя новых форм, распределите четы: Without forming new forms, divide four examples into two columns: an indefinite object and a certain object.
Не объединяй два разных слова в одну «фо: Don’t combine two different words into one form:
Не объясняй форму только как «двойная d»: Don't just explain the form as "double d." Writing is important, but first you need to understand the object:
Не объясняйте anyja и apja правилом «кон: Don't explain anyja and apja by the rule "final a just disappears and j appears." It's not a universal mechanism. At A1 it's safer to learn three complete sets as ready-made models.
Не обязательно запоминать маршрут заране: You don't have to memorize the route in advance. These shapes are the reference points that you'll use to reconstruct it as you read.
Не обязательно использовать все связки.\: You don't have to use all the ligaments. It takes a few natural compounds to make the sentences one situation.
Не обязательно использовать слово: You don't have to use the word.
Не обязательно строить сложный вопрос.\n: You don't have to ask a complicated question. You can repeat the questioning tone of the detail.
Не ограничивайся выбором союза. Для кажд: For each answer, explain which parts are connected and what the logical relationship is.
Не определяй адресата только по окончани: Don't just identify the addressee at the end, first, identify who's talking to whom and to whom the request is addressed.
Не определяй модель только по окончанию: Don't define a model by the end of a verb. For example, iszom ends in -om, but in vizet it is an indefinite form.
Не определяй спряжение только по внешнем: Don't define conjugation by the outer end alone. The forms mi and ti coincide in two paradigms, and kérnék has two different grammatical parsings.
Не определяй спряжение только по окончан: Don't define conjugation only at the end of én. Forms like vártam or olvastam do not by themselves show whether an object was indefinite or certain.
Не определяй тип спряжения по одному око: Don't define the type of conjugation by one end. First ask: is there a straight object and is it definite?
Не ориентируйтесь только на общий процен: Don't just focus on the total percentage. Two students with the same score can make mistakes in different areas: reading, lenni, articles, verbs, numbers or schedules.
Не останавливайся на каждом незнакомом с: Don't stop at every word you don't know.
Don't stop at every word you don't know. First, find the familiar supports: busz, megálló, gyógyszertár, egyenesen, balra, könyvtár.
Не отвечай на вопрос о языках заученной: Don't answer a language question with a phrase you've learned if the level isn't true. In an interview, accuracy is more important than an impressive answer.
Не отвечай по общему впечатлению. Для ка: Don't give a general impression. For each answer, find a specific time, place, transport, action or word of frequency.
Не отвечайте только по инструкции 8.7.mp: Do not answer only 8.7.mp3. activity results require listening to a separate entry of the task.
Не открывай model answer до своей попытк: Don't open model answer before you try. First, structure the message, then check the content, and then compare it to the sample.
Не открывай вопросы как тест на память о: Don't open questions as a test of how to remember individual words. Understand the chronology of history first, and then look for proof for each answer.
Не открывай транскрипт до отправки ответ: Don't open the transcript before you send the answers, otherwise the exercise stops checking the listening and turns into reading.
Не открывай транскрипт до первого прослу: Don't open the transcript until you first listen, otherwise the exercise turns into reading instead of listening.
Не переводи lenne автоматически как «я б: Do not translate lenne automatically as “I would be”. Lenne is third-person singular (“he/she/it would be”, depending on context); the first-person singular form is lennék (“I would be”).
Не переводи várd как «подожди это». В ес: Don't translate várd as "wait for it." In natural speech, it's usually said várd meg őt or várd meg Annát - "wait for him, her or Anna."
Не переводи погодные выражения слово за: Do not translate Hungarian weather expressions word for word from English. English may use patterns such as “it is sunny” or “it is raining”, while Hungarian weather expressions use several different constructions. Learn each Hungarian phrase as a complete unit.
Не переводи русские «в» и «из» механичес: Do not map English prepositions such as “in / into / from / out of” mechanically onto Hungarian suffixes. First identify the spatial relation. Lesson 10 covers only the interior family; Lessons 11–12 introduce other location families.
Не переводи русские «из / от / с» одним: Do not translate every English “from / out of / off / away from” with one Hungarian suffix. -ból/-ből belongs specifically to the interior family. Leaving a surface and moving away from a person or object use other families taught in Lessons 11–12.
Do not translate an English conjunction automatically. English words such as “that”, “so that”, and “if”, or a zero connector, do not map one-to-one onto Hungarian. First identify whether the clause expresses content, purpose, condition, cause, result, or another logical relation, then choose the Hungarian construction.
Не переводи русскую модель слово за слов: Do not translate an English pain expression word for word. English naturally says “My head hurts” or “I have a headache”. Hungarian uses fáj/fájnak with a possessed body-part form, so the possessor is already encoded in fejem, torkom, lábaim, etc.; an extra first-person pronoun is normally unnecessary.
Не переводи связующее слово изолированно: Do not translate a connector in isolation. English may use “and”, “but”, “while”, or “whereas” where Hungarian chooses és, pedig, viszont, or de. Choose the Hungarian connector from the logical relationship between the clauses, not from one English word.
Не переводи текст слово за словом. Снача: Don't translate word for word. First, understand the general situation, then find the specifics of the apartment A and the apartment B a second time.
Не переводи форму автоматически как прям: Do not automatically translate the form as a direct order.
Не переводим любой русский дательный авт: Do not map every English “to” or “for” automatically to -nak/-nek. English usually expresses the recipient with word order or a preposition rather than a noun-case suffix. First check whether the Hungarian meaning is really a recipient or addressee.
Не переводим механически русские «у / к: Do not mechanically map English “at / by / near / to / from” onto Hungarian suffixes. First identify the spatial meaning and the type of relation, then choose the Hungarian location family.
Не переводите каждую форму механически к: Do not translate the forms mechanically. English normally requires a present-tense form of “be”: Diák vagyok means “I am a student.” Hungarian differs especially in the third person: van/vannak are omitted with professions, nationalities, and qualities, but kept for location and existence.
Не переноси автоматически английское пра: Do not assume that English future expressions such as “will” or “be going to” have a one-to-one Hungarian equivalent. Hungarian can naturally use a present-tense verb with a clear future-time marker, so first check the time expression and context.
Не переноси эту модель автоматически на: Don't automatically transfer this model to all city and place names. In Hungarian, the choice of local family often depends on the specific name; the next family starts in lesson 11.
Не переносите профессиональные формулы в: Don't bring professional formulas into the doctor's office mechanically. In the new situation, there will be different words, questions, and forms of appeal.
Не переносите русские слова в венгерское: Do not build a Hungarian sentence by inserting English words or translating word for word. In the third person, do not add van with a profession or nationality. Check the exact forms vagyok, vagy, van, vagyunk, vagytok, vannak.
Не переносите русскую логику «конкретный: English does not change the verb according to whether the direct object is definite, so do not assume that “a specific person” automatically means Hungarian definite conjugation. First- and second-person objects belong to a separate Hungarian pattern that we will work through step by step.
Не переносите русскую форму множественно: Do not copy the English plural after a numeral into Hungarian. English says “two books” and “three houses”, but Hungarian uses the singular noun: két könyv, három ház. The verb is also normally singular with such a quantified subject: Két könyv van az asztalon.
Не переносите это объяснение на любой об: Don't transfer this explanation to any object before the verb. Here the focus is clear by the direct opposition of the verb to the verb.
Не перепутай будущее и знакомое прошедше: Don’t confuse the future with the familiar past:
Не переходи на будущее время или сложные: Don't go to future time or complex structures. Present time is enough for the route: megyek, vagyok, tanulok, jövök and familiar local forms.
Не переходи на новую грамматику. Возьми: Don't go to a new grammar. Take the following time marker:
Не перечисляй много времён подряд. Доста: Don't list too many times in a row. It's just 2-3 reference points that hold the structure of the story.
Не перечитывай список: распознай ситуаци: Do not read the list again: recognize the situation and choose the right phrase.
Не пиши механически *vonatval, *késvel и: Don't write mechanically *vonatval, *késvel or *pénzvel. After consonant, we see the result of assimilation, not a single letter v.
Не пиши полный монолог заранее. Подготов: Don’t write a full monologue in advance, prepare 6-8 keywords and speak in five blocks of meaning.
Don’t write a full monologue in advance. Prepare 6-8 keywords and speak in semantic blocks.
Don't write a full monologue in advance. Prepare 6-8 keywords: product, satellite, price, payment, problem, solution, outcome.
Не пиши полный монолог. Подготовь 6–8 кл: Don't write a full monologue. Prepare 6-8 keywords and speak in the semantic blocks.
Не пиши полный текст заранее. Запиши 6–8: Don't write the full text in advance. Write down 6-8 keywords and talk to them. If you forget a word, make it easy, don't stop.
Не пиши полный текст по готовому образцу: Don't write the full text in a finished sample. First, collect the content by heading, then choose the shapes of the future by context.
Не пишите только список продуктов и не в: Don't just write a list of products or insert forms into -t mechanically. Select a verb first, then determine if a noun is a direct addition: Otthon van kenyér, but Kenyeret veszek.
Не повторяйте всё одинаково. Используйте: Don't repeat it the same way. Use the diagnostics.
Не повторяйте одну и ту же фразу только: Do not repeat the same phrase just to increase the volume.
Не повторяйте правила как изолированные: Don’t repeat the rules as isolated shortcuts. Check them in whole forms: szép / sok, a könyv / az ablak, két könyv / könyvek, Két óra van / kettőkor.
Не повышай PARTIAL до DIRECT только пото: Don't raise PARTIAL to DIRECT just because the student clicked "complete." The evidence view is determined by the type of task and the way the test is conducted.
Не подменяй услышанное догадкой по одном: Don't substitute for guesses one verb for what you hear, listen to the shape of the place.
Не понимай фразу «одно прошедшее время»: Don't understand the phrase "one past tense" as "one unchanging form." The face, the type of conjugation, and the shape of the verb itself are all important.
Не превращай задание в список несвязанны: Don’t turn a task into a list of unrelated phrases. Use familiar L10-L12 forms and routing chunks forms; don’t enter new elapsed time before L13.
Не превращай каждую фразу о завтрашнем д: Don't turn every sentence about tomorrow into a future lesson, but at that level, we first learn the pre-made predictions and react to them.
Не превращай различие «настоящее / fog»: Don't make the "present/fog" distinction a hard rule. Both models can talk about the future; context and communication function are more important than one form.
Не превращай список реплик в механическо: Don't turn a list of lines into a mechanical reading. At each stage, first define the communicative problem, then choose the form.
Не превращай чтение в урок образования в: Don't make reading a lesson in the education of all endings. It's enough to understand who acted and what happened.
Не превращай это в полную таблицу спряже: Don't make this a complete table of conjugation of two verbs. In this lesson, it's enough to understand the contrast of meaning and learn patterns in the context of food.
Не превращай это в правило «прилагательн: Do not turn this into the rule “Hungarian adjectives never change”. In predicate position, a plural subject normally takes a plural adjective: A házak nagyok. This differs from English, where the adjective in “The houses are big” does not change.
Не превращай этот блок в урок сравнитель: Don't make this block a comparative degree lesson, but the goal is to explain why one day is more practical for walking.
Не превращайте окончание -ik в универсал: Don't make the ending -ik into a universal algorithm. Not all modern verbs on -ik behave the same way, and there is variation in spoken language. For the A0 level, learn the frequency verb along with the forms én, te and ő.
Не применяй одно механическое окончание: Don't apply one mechanical ending to all words, for example: torok → torkom — the vowel o falls out; kéz> kezem — the long é is shortened.
Не применяйте к этим словам простую моде: Don’t use the simple vowel + k model to describe these words: forms.
Не применяйте правило «односложное слово: Don’t use the rule “a single word always gets –ak.” Compare: ház>>> házak, láb>> lábak, but nap>>> napok. In addition, some words change the basis: ló>>>> lovak, tükör>>>>>> tükrök, kéz kezek.
Не произносите каждую букву отдельно:: Do not say each letter separately:
Не произносите только отдельные слова:: Don't just say the individual words:
Не просто запоминай число. Сравни инстру: Don't just memorize a number. Compare Anna's instruction and action: that's what shows the error of understanding.
Не путай -kor и -ra/-re: hétkor означает: Don’t confuse –kor and –ra/-re: hétkor means “in seven” and hétre means “to seven/on seven” in the appropriate context.
Не путай Hol? и Hová?: házban = в доме,: Don't confuse Hol? and Hová?: házban = in the house where?; házba = in the house where?. One letter n changes the spatial relation.
Не путай Hol? с направлением. Если предм: Don't confuse Hol? with direction. If an object is already on the surface or a person is already in place, you need to answer Hol?, not the shape of the target.
Не путай Melyik? и Melyiket?. Melyik lak: Don't confuse Melyik? and Melyiket?. Melyik lakás...? — "What apartment ...??" Melyiket választja? — "Which one do you choose?": here you need an object with -t.
Не путай mert и ezért: mert вводит причи: Don’t confuse mert and ezért: mert introduces the cause because, ezért indicates the result because.
Не путай два вопроса: общий вопрос о пог: Don't confuse the two questions: the general question of the weather and the question of the number of degrees. They may describe the same situation, but they require different answers.
Не путай прилагательное перед существите: Do not confuse the adjective before the noun and the adjective-pronounce in the plural: nagy házak, but A házak nagyok. In the present time of the 3rd person, a separate van with such a predicate is not put.
Не путай с дательным падежом прошлого ур: Do not confuse this with the dative from Lesson 15. Here the meaning is instrument/means or accompaniment: English may use “with” or “by”, while Hungarian uses the -val/-vel family.
Не путай три вещи: выбор -val/-vel по га: Don't confuse three things: choosing -val/-vel for harmony, assimilation after consonant, and the communicative function of "what/with whom." These are related but different steps.
Не путай три разные ситуации: késtem — я: Don’t confuse three different situations: késtem — I’m late; késett a busz — the bus is late; lekéstem a buszt — I missed the bus.
Не путай три уровня: описать текущую пог: Don't confuse the three levels: describe the current weather, understand the forecast, and make a decision about the forecast. It's a chain of things, but it's not the same thing.
Не путай это с пропуском уже известного: Don't confuse this with a gap in a known specific object, because in that context, a certain shape can be maintained, and we'll go into detail on 21.3.
Не путайте kér и kérdez. Kér valamit озн: Don’t confuse kér and kérdez. Kér valamit means “to ask, request, or order something.” Kérdez means “to ask, ask a question.”
Не путайте ti и вежливое «Вы». Ti означа: Do not confuse ti with formal address. Ti is informal plural “you”. Hungarian uses Ön for formal address to one person and Önök for formal address to several people. English “you” covers all of these, so pay attention to both number and formality.
Не путайте конечную k основы со множеств: Don't confuse the final k basis with the plural. In ablak, the letter k is part of the word "window." The plural is ablakok. In combination három ablak, the word remains in the singular.
Не путайте русское множественное число с: Do not copy the English plural after a numeral into Hungarian. English “three chairs” is Hungarian három szék, not három székek. Also remember that the definite article a/az does not automatically mean “this”.
Not to be confused with vowel longitude: á, é, í, ó, ő, ú, ű indicate the longitude of the sound, not the place of stress.
Не пытайся выбирать суффикс только по по: Don't try to pick a suffix just by the last letter of a word. Look at vowels and remember frequent forms as solid patterns. Mixed and borrowed words have lexical features.
Не пытайся вывести все семь глаголов одн: Don't try to derive all seven verbs in one formula. They're just about frequency: they need to be quickly learned and used.
Не пытайся вывести всю повелительную пар: Don't try to deduce the entire imperative paradigm from four examples. This is a preliminary observation, not a rule table.
Не пытайся вывести эти четыре формы из о: Don't try to get these four forms out of the same school rule. For the A2 level, it's safer to recognize them as ready-made pairs.
Не пытайся говорить идеально или слишком: Don't try to speak perfectly or too complicated. It's better to have 8 to 12 short, clear sentences from the models you've studied than a long sentence with a new grammar.
Не пытайся говорить сложнее своего уровн: Don't try to speak harder than your level. Better 6-8 simple, clear sentences with the right sequence than a long phrase with a new grammar.
Не пытайся ежедневно делать всё сразу. Н: Don't try to do everything at once every day. A small, stable load is more effective than a rare long, non-repeat session.
Не пытайся запомнить весь текст после од: Don't try to memorize all the text after one listening. First catch only the time marker, then the action and the form.
Не пытайся заранее переносить окончания: Don't try to transfer the L10 endings to every Hungarian place in advance. It's now pretty clear to finish this system.
Не пытайся здесь разбирать по частям фор: Don’t try to disassemble the parts of the form menjek, menjen, forduljon, busszal or leszállnom. In L12 they work as ready-made functional chunks.
Не пытайся использовать новые сложные вр: Don't try to use new difficult times or rules from the following lessons, because there are enough learned forms of the past, simple bundles and understandable chronology.
Не пытайся каждый раз заново вычислять ч: Don't try to recalculate the frequency irregular form every time, remember it with the typical situation and object.
Не пытайся определить тип спряжения толь: Don't try to determine the type of conjugation just by the form én: vártam and kértem look the same in an uncertain and definite past.
Не пытайся отвечать длинно. На A1 достат: Don't try to answer long. A1 will take 1-2 sentences, time, action, one detail and a natural counter-question.
Не пытайся переводить каждое слово подря: Don't try to translate every word in a row. For 7 questions, it's more important to see where Dora is, where she's going, where she comes from, where she meets, and which point is last.
Don't try to translate every word in a row. First, trace the route to local forms. Text time is left in the familiar safe model of whole hours; colloquial fél/negyed is not specifically entered here.
Не пытайся понять каждое слово с первого: Don't try to understand every word the first time. If you open the transcript right away, the exercise becomes reading.
Не пытайся понять каждое слово. Если усл: Don't try to understand every word. If you hear the product, the quantity, the price and the payment method, the main task is already solved.
Не пытайся сделать одну универсальную мо: Don't try to make one universal model like "weather + the same word." Sun, rain, snow, wind and cloud cover use different prefabricated designs.
Не пытайся сейчас выводить окончания усл: Don't try to infer conditional endings right now. Lesson15's goal is to understand and use a few sustainable restaurant phrases.
Не пытайся сейчас разбирать каждое оконч: Don't try to sort out every ending inside polite phrases right now. First, understand WHEN a phrase is needed in a store.
Не пытайся строить длинную фразу. В реал: Don't try to build a long sentence. In a real situation, a short question + clarification + repeating the route is more reliable and natural for the A1 level.
Не пытайся удержать всё предложение цели: Don't try to hold the whole sentence. Especially at a temperature, first fix the number, and then keep listening.
Не пытайтесь автоматически проспрягать к: Don’t try to automatically conjugate each new verb by vocabulary form only. First define the model, then check the forms én, te and ő. Especially carefully study ért, szeret, dolgozik and játszik.
Don’t try to remember every ending.
Не пытайтесь на этом слайде выводить фор: Don't try to output a form on this slide just by the last letter of a word. First define the function: who? what? Forms házat, könyvet and almát while you treat them as ready-made pairs.
Не пытайтесь переводить каждое слово во: Don’t try to translate every word during the first audition, first define the topic of the conversation, then extract specific details.
Не пытайтесь сразу записать каждое слово: Don’t try to write down every word right away.
Не пытайтесь угадывать произношение по р: Do not guess Hungarian pronunciation from an English-style respelling. Use the Hungarian audio as the model. The English translation gives the meaning, not the sound of the word.
Не разбирай mennem как menni + m. Личный: Don’t break mennem down as menni + m. The personal infinitive is a separate form; it changes the ending and sometimes the form of the base.
Не решай всё как задачу на -ik. В больши: Don't solve everything as a problem in -ik. In most of the points, it's more important to see the context: who acts, when, where, where, how often, or what is an object.
Не сверяйте черновик с полным model answ: Don’t check the draft with the full model answer before the first attempt. Write your own text first, then use the model only to analyze the structure and possible corrections.

Прошедшее время образуется по моделям -t: The past time is formed by models -t and -ott/-ett/-ött with personal endings; the choice of model depends on the verb (tanult, olvasott). Fog is used for future time, -na/-ne/-ná/-né - for conditional inclination, -j- - for imperative.
Прошедшее время содержит показатель: The past time contains an indicator
Past time is not one finished form, you have to choose the base, the time period, the personal ending and the appropriate conjugation.
Прошедшее время, объект и хронология — р: Past time, object and chronology - disassemble by steps
Прошедшее значение выражает не только ок: The past value is not just the ending, but the completeness and the sequence are conveyed by context, time words, prefixes and bundles.
Прошедшее нереальное условие — сложная м: The past unreal condition is a complex model, and here it is only repeated and analyzed; do not form it by analogy without checking the forms.
Прошедший момент задают и форма глагола,: The past moment is given by both the shape of the verb and the context, and frequent markers help to quickly put an event on a timeline.
Прямая повелительная форма не всегда гру: A direct Hungarian imperative is not automatically rude, but without supportive context it can sound abrupt. English often softens requests with “please”, modal questions, or intonation; Hungarian also distinguishes informal and formal verb forms. In an official situation, use the appropriate formal Hungarian form.
Прямо говоришь, что хочешь пойти в магаз: You're telling me you want to go to the store.
Прямое дополнение с -t в бытовых ситуаци: Direct addition to -x0 in everyday situations: items, purchases, requests, accessible reading and textual practice without premature full conjugation system.
Прямое дополнение: kit? — кого? · mit? —: Direct addition: kit? - Who? · mit? - What?
Прямой объект → его тип и лицо → форма г: Direct object → its type and face → the form of the verb
